snapshot.description: Fix `parse_skill_file()` in skill.rs: (1) Detect subdirectory format (`wm-*/SKILL.md`) and use parent directory name as skill name, not `file_stem()`. (2) Read `name:` frontmatter field as primary name source with fallback to parent dir name. (3) Add `pub fn load_skills_from_embed()` that reads from rust-embed into the SkillEngine. (4) Update `scan()` to also load embedded skills.
snapshot.title: Fix skill parser for subdirectory format + name field
